evidence: Scans up to the input count (capped at 30) through the record lookup helper, resolves each candidate record, and reads its selector-0 value with attribute_record_value_get. It retains the highest selector-0 value; on equal values it compares get_context_scaled_attribute_0a for the current and retained record before replacing the retained pointer. The chosen pointer is stored to the global slot at 0x7003a7e4b0. Its caller is prepare_mode_dependent_entry_list_records. Source: decompiled/main/main_0050.c:41681-41785; caller decompiled/main/main_0050.c:40419-40432; accepted callees tools/data/function_annotations.tsv:12038 (attribute_record_pointer_get_or_default), 85 (attribute_record_value_get), 623 (get_context_scaled_attribute_0a).

On the enabled context paths, resets summary fields in the supplied object, calls the accepted build_baseball_game_result_summary helper, then populates contextual attribute-list entries through format_contextual_attribute_list_entries; it also runs the associated summary initialization helpers. The parent handler reaches this routine for action IDs 0x235/0x236 under state checks. Source: decompiled/main/main_0108.c:28169-28282; caller decompiled/main/main_0108.c:28324-28333; accepted helper names at tools/data/function_annotations.tsv:11816 (build_baseball_game_result_summary), 11726 (format_contextual_attribute_list_entries).

Builds a large temporary/output record using context and status helper calls: obtains status selector 0x13, maps it through the accepted map_attribute_context_status_19_to_40_or_93 helper, prepares status-dependent intermediate values and invokes record-population helpers before returning. Its indexed caller is f_7000754ca8, which groups it with sibling context-status/category record builders. The exact record domain and individual field meanings remain unresolved, so the label stays broad. Source: decompiled/main/main_0054.c:5475-5582; caller decompiled/main/main_0054.c:7901-7905; accepted helper at tools/data/function_annotations.tsv:12033; caller family at tools/data/function_annotations.tsv:347,370.

Rejects when attribute-context status selector 0x13 equals 6 or the nested provider is unavailable. Otherwise it queries nested provider float selectors 0x4a through 0x4f in order and returns the index 0 through 5 for the first value comparing at least 1.0; returns 0xfffffffe when no selector qualifies. Its caller consumes the result as a code. Source: decompiled/main/main_0119.c:27205-27317; caller decompiled/main/main_0119.c:4869-4876; accepted helpers at tools/data/function_annotations.tsv:77 and nested selector helper behavior in decompiled/function_behavior.tsv.

After record-interface and attribute-record resolution, reads selector 0x0c through attribute_record_value_get and maps the value through fixed descending thresholds 0x7c, 0x77, 0x6d, 0x63, 0x59, 0x54, 0x4f, and 0x2d to discrete integer codes. Invalid lookup/dispatch paths return 0xfffffffe. Its caller stores the returned code in object state.
